title: Infinity is bigger than you think - Numberphile
summary: Numberphile's James Grime explains Cantor's result that some infinities are bigger than others, including why the reals outnumber the integers. It is a short, accessible introduction to countable and uncountable infinity.
why: HN people recommend it as a clear introduction to different sizes of infinity that non-mathematicians can follow.

quote.text: Numberphile did a pretty good introductory video to this if you want to learn more
